title: Novel Release v4 — fixed package layout
description: Producer-side contract. The website does not execute this schema or validate naming, duplicates, ordering or content. Root contains text/, images/, README.md and release.json.

icon.description: Package-relative book icon. The filename and supported image extension are producer-owned.

volumes.description: Authoritative volume order. Do not sort by ID or filesystem order.

segment.description: Producer-owned single URL and filesystem path segment, with no numeric requirement. The producer owns uniqueness and filesystem safety.

id.description: Chapter file is text/<volume-id>/<chapter-id>.md. ID omits .md; README is reserved for the volume introduction.
Volume directory name. Introduction is always text/<volume-id>/README.md.

chapters.description: Authoritative chapter order within this volume.
